summary.text: One of the twelve suitors from Ithaca in Apollodorus' list — not to be confused with Amphialus son of Polyneus, the Phaeacian who excelled at leaping before Odysseus on Scheria.

story.text: Apollodorus counts Amphialus among the twelve suitors who came from Ithaca itself to devour Odysseus' house while the king was long away at Troy.
